messages:
noah: heads-up found partner S3 archive with multiple files containing Vault transit ciphertext headers and truncated oauth fragments. copying a redacted sample: `{"path":"s3://partner-logs/2026/03/25/a.gz","ct":"v3:CiQAXXX...","tok":"pa_9a***b"}`

anya: quarantine first. do not delete until we record hashes. i'll create gs://redwood-sec-quarantine/ and set private ACLs.

priya: triage checklist: (1) suspend partner SA keys (2) revoke partner Vault tokens with `-prefix partner-` (3) remove decrypt IAM binding for partner principal (4) enable audit sink for KMS and Vault decrypts (90d) (5) search other buckets/objects for ciphertext patterns.

sec-bot: incident created INC-2026-1315 (partner-log-credential-exposure).

vault-bot: suggested commands: `vault token revoke -prefix partner-` and `vault list auth/partner/creds || true` to enumerate.

noah: copying 8 files to quarantine now and setting ACL=private. saving hex hashes for each object. starting grep across partner buckets for `v[0-9]+:` and `partial_token` patterns.

anya: drafting partner comms: ask them to rotate tokens on their side, stop sending raw logs, and run our redaction lib. requirement: confirm rotation and share new SA key IDs before re-enabling access.

priya: I'll run immediate IAM and Vault actions. disallow `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` for partner principal, suspend SA keys with `gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEYID`, then run Vault revocations. enabling KMS audit export to BigQuery now.

noah: scan found 15 more gzip files in two additional prefixes. quarantined and hashed. moving findings to INC-2026-1315.

anya: owners: noah = quarantine + scan, priya = revokes + audit sink + Vault TTL tighten, anya = partner comms and verification. check-in in 20m. posting follow-ups to the incident channel for async updates. :white_check_mark:
